2026-10-30.subject: Daily Status Report - 30-10-2026
2026-10-30.raw_body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find below my work status for today.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY'S WORK (30-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. HRM Salary Arrears screen (GESCOM ERP and Employee Portal)
   a) Existing Basic is now editable in the arrears grid. When it is
      changed, Basic Difference, DP, DA, HRA, CPS 14%/10%, Total,
      Deductions and Net Payable are recalculated immediately, along
      with the employee subtotals and grand total.
   b) Existing Basic and Revised Basic can be entered and updated for
      any year, including months that are already Recommended or
      Approved. The edited values are saved through
      USP_HRMSalaryArrears.
   c) DA % is now taken from DAEffectiveDateCapture in the same way as
      the DA Effective Date Capture screen. Each month uses the entry
      for that month, or the last entry before it if the month has no
      entry of its own.
   d) DP rule applied: DP is 0 for 2023 and for Jan-2024 to Jul-2024.
      From Aug-2024 onwards DP is 31% of the Basic Difference.
   e) All the above changes were made in both the GESCOM ERP source
      and the Employee Portal source.

2. Employee Salary Bill Approval screen (GESCOM ERP)
   a) Redesigned the screen to be more user friendly, in four clear
      sections: Pending Bills, Salary Period, Earnings and Deductions,
      and Certification and Approval.
   b) Added a search box, a highlighted selected bill, side-by-side
      Earnings and Deductions with totals, and a Gross / Deduction /
      Net Pay summary. The Approve and Return buttons are now
      different colours so they are easy to tell apart.
   c) The approval logic is unchanged. Only the design was changed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TOMORROW'S PLAN (31-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Work on the Salary Fund Request Budget screen.
2. Test the Salary Arrears changes (Existing Basic edit, DA %, DP
   rule) end to end in both ERP and Employee Portal, and check that
   the stored procedure saves and returns the edited Existing Basic.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
LEARNINGS FROM TODAY
-----------------------------------------------------------------


1. When the same screen exists in two projects (ERP and Employee
   Portal), the changes should be applied carefully to each file
   rather than copying the whole file, because each project has its
   own differences.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Regards,
Venkata Sai

--
